description: Simple search: which computer connected to which, and when. Made for non-network users.

panels.title: Connections found
panels.description: How many connections match your search. The list shows at most the newest 1000 - if this number is higher, narrow the time range. No result does not prove there was no connection (devices only sample traffic).

targets.query:
WITH
    trimBoth(${src:singlequote}) AS want_src,
    trimBoth(${dst:singlequote}) AS want_dst,
    trimBoth(${port:singlequote}) AS want_port,
    (isIPv4String(want_src) OR isIPv6String(want_src)) AS src_is_ip,
    (length(splitByChar('/', want_src)) = 2 AND (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1]) OR isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1])) AND match(splitByChar('/', want_src)[2], '^[0-9]{1,3}$') AND toUInt16OrZero(splitByChar('/', want_src)[2]) <= if(isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1]), 32, 128)) AS src_is_net,
    (isIPv4String(want_dst) OR isIPv6String(want_dst)) AS dst_is_ip,
    (length(splitByChar('/', want_dst)) = 2 AND (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1]) OR isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1])) AND match(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[2], '^[0-9]{1,3}$') AND toUInt16OrZero(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[2]) <= if(isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1]), 32, 128)) AS dst_is_net,
    (want_src != '' OR want_dst != '')
      AND (want_src = '' OR src_is_ip OR src_is_net)
      AND (want_dst = '' OR dst_is_ip OR dst_is_net)
      AND (want_port = '' OR match(want_port, '^[0-9]{1,5}$')) AS inputs_ok
SELECT if(inputs_ok, count(), NULL) AS matches
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND inputs_ok
  AND (want_src = '' OR if(src_is_net,
        isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), if(src_is_net, want_src, '0.0.0.0/32')),
        ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = want_src))
  AND (want_dst = '' OR if(dst_is_net,
        isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), if(dst_is_net, want_dst, '0.0.0.0/32')),
        ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = want_dst))
  AND (want_port = '' OR toString(dst_port) = want_port)

panels.title: Summary: who talked to whom (first and last time)
panels.description: One row per From / To / Port combination, with the first and last time it was seen in the selected time range (max 200 rows).

targets.query:
WITH
    trimBoth(${src:singlequote}) AS want_src,
    trimBoth(${dst:singlequote}) AS want_dst,
    trimBoth(${port:singlequote}) AS want_port,
    (isIPv4String(want_src) OR isIPv6String(want_src)) AS src_is_ip,
    (length(splitByChar('/', want_src)) = 2 AND (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1]) OR isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1])) AND match(splitByChar('/', want_src)[2], '^[0-9]{1,3}$') AND toUInt16OrZero(splitByChar('/', want_src)[2]) <= if(isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1]), 32, 128)) AS src_is_net,
    (isIPv4String(want_dst) OR isIPv6String(want_dst)) AS dst_is_ip,
    (length(splitByChar('/', want_dst)) = 2 AND (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1]) OR isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1])) AND match(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[2], '^[0-9]{1,3}$') AND toUInt16OrZero(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[2]) <= if(isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1]), 32, 128)) AS dst_is_net,
    (want_src != '' OR want_dst != '')
      AND (want_src = '' OR src_is_ip OR src_is_net)
      AND (want_dst = '' OR dst_is_ip OR dst_is_net)
      AND (want_port = '' OR match(want_port, '^[0-9]{1,5}$')) AS inputs_ok
SELECT
    ipToStr(src_addr, etype) AS from_ip,
    ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) AS to_ip,
    dst_port AS to_port,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), ''), '-') AS application,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(time_received_ns)) AS first_time,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max(time_received_ns)) AS last_time,
    count() AS times,
    sum(bytes_norm) AS data_size
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND inputs_ok
  AND (want_src = '' OR if(src_is_net,
        isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), if(src_is_net, want_src, '0.0.0.0/32')),
        ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = want_src))
  AND (want_dst = '' OR if(dst_is_net,
        isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), if(dst_is_net, want_dst, '0.0.0.0/32')),
        ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = want_dst))
  AND (want_port = '' OR toString(dst_port) = want_port)
GROUP BY from_ip, to_ip, to_port, application
ORDER BY last_time DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Every connection (newest first, up to 1000)
panels.description: Each row is one connection. Time = when the connection started, as reported by the network device. If 'Connections found' is above 1000, older ones are not listed - narrow the time range.

targets.query:
WITH
    trimBoth(${src:singlequote}) AS want_src,
    trimBoth(${dst:singlequote}) AS want_dst,
    trimBoth(${port:singlequote}) AS want_port,
    (isIPv4String(want_src) OR isIPv6String(want_src)) AS src_is_ip,
    (length(splitByChar('/', want_src)) = 2 AND (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1]) OR isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1])) AND match(splitByChar('/', want_src)[2], '^[0-9]{1,3}$') AND toUInt16OrZero(splitByChar('/', want_src)[2]) <= if(isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_src)[1]), 32, 128)) AS src_is_net,
    (isIPv4String(want_dst) OR isIPv6String(want_dst)) AS dst_is_ip,
    (length(splitByChar('/', want_dst)) = 2 AND (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1]) OR isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1])) AND match(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[2], '^[0-9]{1,3}$') AND toUInt16OrZero(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[2]) <= if(isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', want_dst)[1]), 32, 128)) AS dst_is_net,
    (want_src != '' OR want_dst != '')
      AND (want_src = '' OR src_is_ip OR src_is_net)
      AND (want_dst = '' OR dst_is_ip OR dst_is_net)
      AND (want_port = '' OR match(want_port, '^[0-9]{1,5}$')) AS inputs_ok
SELECT
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(if(time_flow_start_ns < toDateTime64('2001-01-01 00:00:00', 9), time_received_ns, time_flow_start_ns)) AS time,
    ipToStr(src_addr, etype) AS from_ip,
    ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) AS to_ip,
    dst_port AS to_port,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), ''), '-') AS application,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    bytes_norm AS data_size
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND inputs_ok
  AND (want_src = '' OR if(src_is_net,
        isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), if(src_is_net, want_src, '0.0.0.0/32')),
        ipToStr(src_addr, etype) = want_src))
  AND (want_dst = '' OR if(dst_is_net,
        isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), if(dst_is_net, want_dst, '0.0.0.0/32')),
        ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) = want_dst))
  AND (want_port = '' OR toString(dst_port) = want_port)
ORDER BY time_received_ns DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: How to use this page (click to open)

options.content:
### Find out which computer talked to which, and when

1. Type a **Source IP** (the computer that started the connection) and/or a **Destination IP** (the computer it connected to) in the boxes above. You can leave one of them empty.
2. Optionally type a **Port**, e.g. `443` for HTTPS websites, `3389` for Remote Desktop, `53` for DNS.
3. Pick the **time range** at the top right (default: last 24 hours). Times are shown in your browser's time zone.

Type full addresses like `10.10.36.36` (not `10.10.36`). A subnet also works, e.g. `10.10.36.0/24`. If the box on the right says *Type a valid IP above*, check what you typed. Data is kept for 30 days.

**Good to know:** each row is one connection, as reported by the network devices. Very short connections can be missed (devices only sample traffic), so *no result does not prove there was no connection*. Only connections **from** Source **to** Destination are shown; swap the two boxes to see the other direction.
